merkmale_rules_summary: Official rules of the Orientierungshilfe (No. 10 of the Mietspiegel)
abschlag_intro: For older flats that the landlord rents out without a Sammelheizung, without a bathroom (Bad) or without both, the Mietspiegel states a fixed deduction. The toilet must be inside the flat, though. Sammelheizung means (No. 6.3): the heat comes from one central point. A heating system for one floor or one flat (Etagenheizung or Wohnungsheizung: gas, oil, electric) that heats all living rooms adequately also counts. Bad means: a separate room in the flat with a bathtub or shower and hot water. The official text:
calc_year_intro: Enter the date on which the rent increase letter reached you. The site then chooses the right Mietspiegel. You can also choose the year yourself.
calc_date_hint: Leave empty if you choose the year yourself.
calc_year_auto: For this date the site uses the Mietspiegel {year}.
calc_year_none: The site has no matching Mietspiegel for this date. It only contains the 2024 and 2026 editions.
calc_wohnlage_help: The Wohnlage depends on the exact address. It is listed in the street directory of the Mietspiegel. You can also find it in the online lookup of the State of Berlin. The map in the Mietspiegel is only a rough overview.
calc_wohnlage_link: Look up the Wohnlage for your address
calc_baualter_label: Building age (year the building was ready for occupancy)
calc_baualter_hint: Usually the year the building was completed counts. A modernised flat as a rule keeps the original year. Exceptions exist, e.g. for reconstruction or attic conversions. For 1973 to 1990 it matters whether the building is in former East or West Berlin. So-called Wendewohnungen (financed with GDR funds, construction started before 3 October 1990 but completed only afterwards) belong to ‘1973 bis 1990 Ost’, not to ‘1991 bis 2001’. Flats in West-Staaken (today part of Spandau) count as East.
calc_area_hint: What counts is the real size of the flat, not the number in the tenancy agreement (BGH, judgment of 18.11.2015, VIII ZR 266/14). If you think the number in the agreement is too large, get advice.
calc_minder_label: The landlord did not provide a Sammelheizung, did not provide a bathroom (Bad), or neither. The toilet is inside the flat, though. Deduction: {eur} per m². According to the Mietspiegel (No. 6.3), Sammelheizung means: the heat comes from one central point. A heating system for one floor or one flat (Etagenheizung or Wohnungsheizung: gas, oil, electric) that heats all living rooms adequately also counts as Sammelheizung. Bad means: a separate room in the flat with a bathtub or shower and hot water (for example an instantaneous water heater, a boiler or a central system). If the toilet is outside the flat, the Mietspiegel does not apply.
calc_row_incomplete: Please choose the Wohnlage and building age and enter the living space.
calc_row_none: The Mietspiegel has no value for these details.
calc_row_none_hint: Check Wohnlage, building age and living space. Some combinations do not occur in the Mietspiegel.
calc_row_per_sqm_note: All values: net cold rent in euros per m² per month. For a normally equipped flat the comparative rent is usually around the average value. The features below move it up or down.
calc_features_intro: Tick what exists in your flat, in the building and in the surroundings. Each of the five groups is counted: if there are more plus features, the group counts as plus. If there are more minus features, it counts as minus. If they are equal, it does not count.
calc_self_title: Installed by the tenant does not count
calc_self_text: If a tenant installed something themselves and the landlord did not pay back the costs, it does not count (Mietspiegel No. 6.3). In that case tick “installed and paid for by me”.
calc_compare_label: I compare with what the landlord ticked
calc_compare_hint: A second column “Landlord” appears. The site then shows where you disagree.
calc_self_installed: installed and paid for by me (does not count)
calc_not_for_baualter: Does not apply to the chosen building age.
calc_exclusive_blocked: Not possible: another feature in this energy group is already ticked (either/or).
calc_energy_summary: Enter the value from the energy certificate
calc_energy_intro: Does the energy certificate (Energieausweis) show a value in kWh/(m²·a)? Then the site ticks the matching energy boxes according to the rules of the Mietspiegel. Use the final energy value (Endenergieverbrauch or Endenergiebedarf). The primary energy value (Primärenergie) on the same sheet is often much lower and does not fit here.
calc_energy_value: Final energy value (Endenergie) in kWh/(m²·a) (not primary energy, Primärenergie)
calc_energy_bedarf: The value is an energy demand (Bedarfsausweis), not consumption. The limits are then raised by 20 %.
calc_energy_water: Hot water is produced inside the flat (for example with an instantaneous water heater). Then the official rule adds 20 kWh/(m²·a). Read the rule for your Mietspiegel year:
calc_energy_water_excl: Hot water is not included in the value of the energy certificate. This happens when it is produced inside the flat (for example with an instantaneous water heater) and the certificate has no line ‘Warmwasserzuschlag’ (hot-water surcharge). Only then does the official rule add 20 kWh/(m²·a). The rule for your Mietspiegel year:
calc_energy_invalid: Please enter a number greater than 0.
calc_energy_done: {n} energy boxes ticked. Please check the result below.
calc_result_wait: The result appears as soon as the row is found.
calc_result_title: Local comparative rent based on your details
calc_result_monthly: For {area} m² this is per month (net cold rent):
calc_line_span_up: Distance from average to upper value
calc_line_span_down: Distance from average to lower value
calc_line_delta: Surcharge or deduction: sum {net} × one fifth (20 %) of the distance
calc_conflict_mine: Two variants of the energy features are ticked. Only one is allowed (either/or).
calc_conflict_landlord: The landlord ticked both variants of the energy features.
calc_conflict_landlord_text: According to the Mietspiegel (No. 10.4) you may tick either the feature “insulation or heating system” or the energy value features, not both.
calc_abschlag_note: According to the Mietspiegel, the deduction for substandard amenities (Minderausstattung) is not part of the qualified Mietspiegel (No. 9.4).
calc_oh_note: According to the Mietspiegel, the Orientierungshilfe is a recommended estimation aid. It is not part of the qualified Mietspiegel (No. 10). The list of features is not complete: in individual cases other important features can count (No. 10.1). The result is therefore only an estimate.
calc_disp_title: Here you disagree with the landlord
calc_disp_plus: Plus features the landlord claims but you do not see
calc_disp_minus: Minus features that exist but the landlord left out
calc_disp_other: There are also {n} more differences in your favour (the landlord lists more minus or fewer plus features).
calc_disp_none: Your details and the landlord’s are the same.
calc_demand_label: New rent demanded (net cold rent, € per month)
calc_demand_hint: It is in the rent increase letter.
calc_demand_over: The rent demanded is {diff} per month above your result.
calc_demand_within: The rent demanded is not above your result.
calc_demand_implausible: Please check your entries. The rent demanded or the living space is not plausible (less than €1 per m²).
calc_demand_detail: Demanded: {demanded} per month ({per_sqm} per m²). Your result: {ovm} per m², i.e. {monthly} per month.
calc_demand_cap_hint: There is also a cap (Kappungsgrenze) and there are deadlines. Check them in the next step.
chk_intro: All amounts are net cold rent per month, i.e. without service charges and heating. Only the first three fields are required. The more you fill in, the more precise the result.
chk_in_received: When did the letter reach you?
chk_in_received_hint: The day the letter arrived at your home, not the date written on the letter.
chk_in_demanded_rent: New rent according to the letter (€ per month)
chk_in_demanded_rent_hint: Net cold rent the landlord demands.
chk_in_current_rent_hint: Net cold rent you pay now.
chk_in_area_hint: Needed to calculate the comparative rent per month.
chk_in_last_change: Since when has your rent applied, leaving out increases for modernisation or service charges?
chk_in_last_change_hint: Date of the last rent increase or of moving in. Increases for modernisation or service charges (§§ 559 to 560 BGB) do not count here.
chk_in_rent_3y_ago: Rent three years before the day the new rent is to apply (€ per month)
chk_in_rent_3y_ago_hint: If your rent has stayed the same since that day, leave the field empty. If your tenancy started later, enter the rent when you moved in.
chk_in_increases_559_560: Increases of the net cold rent after modernisation (§ 559 BGB) in these three years (€ per month)
chk_in_increases_559_560_hint: Only increases of the cold rent after modernisation. Do not enter changes of your advance payments for service charges or heating here. Only if your rent includes a flat rate for service charges do increases of that flat rate count too.
chk_in_requested_effective: From when should the new rent apply according to the letter?
chk_take_from_calc: Use the value from the calculator: {value} (Mietspiegel {year})
chk_need_received: Please first enter when the letter reached you.
chk_find_sperrfrist_fail: By the fixed calculation rule and your details: less than one year since the last increase. According to case law, such a demand is then invalid.
chk_find_wartefrist_postponed: The new rent can only apply later.
chk_find_over_cap: The rent demanded is above the cap (Kappungsgrenze).
chk_find_over_ovm: The rent demanded is above the local comparative rent based on your details.
chk_find_within_limits: Based on your details, none of the limits checked is exceeded.
chk_find_no_ovm: The comparative rent is still missing. Without it the most important limit cannot be checked.
chk_find_requested_too_early: The landlord names a date that is too early for the new rent.
chk_out_effective: Earliest date the new rent applies
chk_out_sue_deadline: Deadline for the landlord to sue
chk_out_sperrfrist_earliest_received: Earliest date for a new demand (Sperrfrist)
chk_out_wartefrist_earliest_effective: Earliest date for a new rent (Wartefrist)
chk_out_max_rent: Calculated upper limit based on your details
chk_effective_postponed: Without the waiting period it would be {regular}.
chk_wartefrist_postpones: Not complied with. The new rent then only applies from this date.
chk_calc_year_mismatch: Your calculator result is based on the Mietspiegel {calc}. For this letter the Mietspiegel {need} applies. Please recalculate with {need}.
chk_over_by: The rent demanded is {over} per month above it.
chk_partial_title: The rent demanded is above the calculated upper limit, or the letter may have come too early
chk_partial_text: Get advice before you reply. Read the notes on the reply letter. Consent or partial consent is binding.
letter_intro: Choose a template. The explanations are in your language; the letter itself is always in German.
letter_step_explain: When does this letter fit? What to watch out for?
letter_warn_consent: If you consent, you owe the new rent (§ 558b Abs. 1 BGB). The new rent then counts as agreed. This applies even if the increase was not actually allowed.
letter_warn_partial: If you consent to part of it, you owe the rent up to that amount. The landlord can sue for consent to the rest (§ 558b BGB). Afterwards, pay only the amount you consented to.
letter_deadline: Based on your details, your deadline for consent ends on {date}.
letter_features_from_calc: Preselected from your comparison in the calculator (Mietspiegel {year}). You can change the selection.
letter_text_intro: You can still edit the text here. Note: these changes are not saved. If you change something above afterwards or reload the page, the text is created again. So copy, save or print the letter right after editing it.
letter_missing: {n} details are still missing. They are marked ______ in the letter.
letter_send_text:
Read the whole letter and sign it.

Send it in a way that lets you prove later that it arrived, for example by registered mail with proof of delivery (Einwurf-Einschreiben) or with a witness who sees it being put in the letterbox. Keep a copy.
letter_field_landlord_name: Name of the landlord or property management
letter_field_demand_date: Date on the rent increase letter
scope_step: Does this check fit your letter?
scope_intro: This page only applies to a rent increase up to the local comparative rent under § 558 BGB. Other increases follow other rules. In those cases you usually have to pay the higher rent even without consenting.
scope_ask: Does the letter ask you to consent to the increase?
scope_ask_hint: Typical German words: „Zustimmung“, „Mieterhöhungsverlangen“, „§ 558 BGB“, „ortsübliche Vergleichsmiete“, „Mietspiegel“. If the landlord only writes that they are raising the rent under § 558 BGB or to the local comparative rent (ortsübliche Vergleichsmiete), also answer “Yes”. Even then the increase only applies if you consent.
scope_items_legend: Does any of this apply? (Tick everything that fits.)
scope_item_sozial: Old social housing flat with „Kostenmiete“ (cost rent): the letter says for example „Kostenmiete“, „Wirtschaftlichkeitsberechnung“ or „Wohnungsbindungsgesetz“. Do not tick this if you only have a housing entitlement certificate (Wohnberechtigungsschein, WBS).
scope_item_gefoerdert: Newer social housing or another subsidised flat without „Kostenmiete“ (cost rent) (the maximum rent is set by the subsidy)
scope_item_mod559: The increase is because of a modernisation (§ 559 BGB)
scope_item_bk560: It is about service or heating charges, for example new advance payments (§ 560 BGB)
scope_item_index_staffel: Your contract has an index rent or a graduated rent (§§ 557a, 557b BGB)
scope_item_s549: Room furnished by the landlord in the landlord’s own flat (not if you live there permanently with your family or partner), flat let only for temporary use (a contract with an end date alone is not enough), or room in a student or youth residence (Studenten- oder Jugendwohnheim) (§ 549 BGB)
scope_item_efh: Flat in a one- or two-family house or a terraced house
scope_item_neubau: The building was completed after the period of the Mietspiegel (Mietspiegel 2026: from 2025, Mietspiegel 2024: from 2023)
scope_item_wc_out: The toilet is outside the flat
scope_not558_title: This check does not fit your letter
scope_not558_text:
This check only fits a rent increase under § 558 BGB.

– Modernisation, service charges, index or graduated rent, Kostenmiete (cost rent): you often owe the higher rent even without your consent.
– Room furnished by the landlord, flat for temporary use, student or youth residence: the rules on rent increases do not apply. What applies depends on your contract. The landlord can also give you notice more easily there.
– None of these? Then show the letter to an advice centre. For an increase up to the local comparative rent, the landlord needs your consent.

Do not simply stop paying. Otherwise you build up rent arrears. Get advice right away.
scope_notms_title: The Berlin Mietspiegel does not apply to this flat
scope_notms_text: The Mietspiegel only applies to flats that are not price-bound (nicht preisgebunden, i.e. no fixed subsidised rent) in buildings with at least three flats, with the toilet inside the flat, completed within the period of the Mietspiegel (Mietspiegel No. 3). The calculator therefore cannot work out your comparative rent. Get advice. For newer social housing or another subsidised flat, the landlord must still ask you for your consent. In addition, the rent must not exceed the maximum rent set by the subsidy.
scope_unsure_text: The results below only apply to a demand under § 558 BGB that asks for your consent. If you are not sure, show the letter to an advice centre before you reply or stop paying.
scope_unanswered: Please first answer the question in step 1. Then you will see the result.
scope_results_hidden: For your case we do not show a result here (see the note above).
calc_scope_intro: The Berlin Mietspiegel only applies to flats that are not price-bound (nicht preisgebunden) in buildings with at least three flats (Mietspiegel No. 3).
calc_year_newer: Note: the Mietspiegel {newer} is based on rents as of {stichtag}. Your letter arrived after that date but before the Mietspiegel {newer} applied. A court may therefore also use the Mietspiegel {newer}. Calculate with both years and get advice.
calc_baualter_new: Was the building completed in {year} or later? Then the {ms} does not apply.
calc_condition_check: Please check this condition yourself. The calculator cannot apply it:
calc_energy_denkmal: If the building is a listed monument, the minus energy features may not count:
calc_rounding_note: Rounding: the Mietspiegel does not say whether to round per group or once at the end. Here it is rounded once. The difference is at most a few cents.
chk_in_lwu: My landlord is a state-owned housing company
chk_rent_3y_date: This means your net cold rent on {date}.
chk_cap_assumed: Here {base} was assumed to be your rent on {date}.
chk_pay_from_later: The landlord names a later date. You then only have to pay the new rent from {date}.

chk_find_need_rent_3y_text: You did not enter the rent from three years ago, so the site used your current rent. If your rent on {base_date} was lower, the cap is lower. Enter the rent from back then.
chk_find_over_lwu: The rent demanded is above the commitments of the state-owned companies
chk_find_over_lwu_text: Based on your details, the increase is above {lwu_cap}. These commitments are voluntary. Whether they can be enforced in court is unclear. Ask the company, the ombudsman office or an advice centre.
chk_find_no_last_change: The blocking period and the waiting period have not been checked
chk_find_no_last_change_text: Enter since when your current rent has applied. Only then can the site check whether the letter came too early.
letter_findings_title: Warning: the check found a problem
letter_findings_text: If you consent now, even only partly, your consent is still binding. Be sure to get advice before you consent.
letter_no_check_title: You have not checked the deadlines and limits yet
letter_incomplete_title: Your check is not complete yet
letter_no_check_text: Before consenting, check whether the letter came too early and whether the rent is above the limits.
letter_binding_text:
With your consent, the new rent is agreed. As a rule you cannot withdraw the consent.

Did your tenancy start on or after 01.06.2015? Then first check whether the rent was already too high when you moved in (rent brake, Mietpreisbremse). Against a rent you have consented to, as a rule, you can no longer rely on the rent brake (BGH, judgment of 28.09.2022, VIII ZR 300/21).

Do not put conditions into a consent („nur wenn …“, “only if …”). Do not sign a form from the landlord that you do not fully understand.
letter_problem_agreed_not_between: The amount does not fit: it must be higher than your current rent and lower than the rent demanded.
letter_problem_agreed_over_max: The amount is above the upper limit calculated from your details ({max}). You are bound by it if you consent.
letter_problem_new_over_demanded: The amount does not fit: the new rent must be higher than your current rent and must not be higher than the rent demanded.
chk_year_contested: Your letter arrived after the rents for the Mietspiegel {newer} were surveyed but before it applied. A court may therefore also use the Mietspiegel {newer}. Calculate with {year} and with {newer} in the calculator and get advice.
chk_consent_193: If the deadline ends on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday, the wording of § 193 BGB moves it to the next working day, here {date}. Whether this applies here is not settled. So reply by the date shown above.
chk_shifted_193: By calculation the deadline ends on {date}. That is a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday, so it moves to the next working day (§ 193 BGB).
chk_invalid_number: We cannot read this number. Write for example 1234.56 or 1234 (no thousands comma).
calc_minder_outside_label: The landlord did not provide a Sammelheizung or did not provide a bathroom (Bad) (or neither).
calc_minder_outside: For flats of this building age without Sammelheizung or without a bathroom, the Mietspiegel gives no value. The tables only apply to fully equipped flats (No. 9). Get advice.
